additional_info.subject: @NOC team
additional_info.body: Charger was offline on SCB, we had asked customer to reboot from OCPP, however, we currently see that no OCPP has been configured on the charger. The charger also came back online, after checking logs, I saw that the reason for the charger going offline was there was an update done on 27th December. I asked the customer if we can close the ticket, however they are not willing to close as fault occur “sporadically” according to them. Since this charger is back online, I did not see any fault on the charger. So I am not sure how to proceed. Please discuss with Si-D expert / other NOC colleagues on how to proceed in the case.
